## Invariants

| # | Invariant | Result | Evidence |
| -- | -- | -- | -- |
| I2 | `T0` is `T`'s first parent and strictly precedes `T` | PASS | 1000 queries checked, 0 violations |
| I3 | `T` contributes zero historical features to itself | PASS | H re-derived without folding `T` reproduces the frozen ranking exactly |
| I7 | `historyTxnCount` equals eligible transactions strictly before `T` | PASS | 1000 queries checked, 0 mismatches (T never folded into its own features) |
| I5 | `B0` is source-independent | PASS | byte-identical under permuted **and** emptied `S(T)` |
| I6 | `B1` is history-independent | PASS | reproduces frozen ranking with no accumulator access |
| I9 | `Suite(T0)` holds only paths extant at `T0` | PASS | 1000 suites recomputed from T0 trees, 0 mismatches |

The expanding window (§9) is enforced **structurally**, not by filtering: the
miner walks the first-parent chain oldest→newest, and on reaching an evaluation
transaction it snapshots the count tables, ranks, and only then folds `T`'s own
contribution in. `T` therefore cannot contribute to its own features.
